theater: 江華島要塞群與漢江口

battle.name: 丙寅洋擾
battle.theater: 江華島要塞群與漢江口
battle.brief: 一八六六年十月，法國遠東艦隊由海軍少將羅澤率領，自芝罘出發攻打江華島，封死漢江口，圖以漕糧斷絕迫使朝鮮讓步；海軍陸戰隊在文殊山城、鼎足山城兩度受挫，十一月廿二日撤走。交戰雙方用的都是上一代火炮，卡面加特林機槍當年尚未踏足東亞。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰的一方是朝鮮王朝：高宗李㷩一八六四年即位時年僅十一歲，國政實際由攝政興宣大院君李昰應主持，兵權集中在御營中軍、訓練都監、巡撫營與各鎭管衙門手中，兵源除中央軍與各道鎭營外，還有大批團練義勇。另一方是法蘭西第二帝國：遠東艦隊司令海軍少將皮埃爾·古斯塔夫·羅澤率七艘軍艦與海軍陸戰隊作戰，旗艦為三六〇〇噸的巡防艦戰士號，出動兵力約六百至八百人，另有駐橫濱的海兵三百人待命；駐北京代理公使亨利·德·貝洛內在外交上越權施壓，向總理衙門提出照會，甚至聲稱要廢黜朝鮮國王。清朝作為宗主國被捲入其中：恭親王奕訢主持的總理衙門答覆法方，認為朝鮮內政外交自主、清廷不便干涉，但仍把消息傳達朝鮮並令其加緊戒備；同年一月俄國船隊出現在朝鮮東岸要求通商與居留，令朝中議論紛紛，洋擾的國際背景就這樣疊在教難之上。
countriesEn: One side was the Joseon dynasty: King Gojong, enthroned in 1864 at the age of eleven, wore the crown while the regent Heungseon Daewongun, his father Yi Ha-ung, actually ran the government, and military authority rested with the Royal Camp, the Training Directorate, the provincial inspectorates and the garrison offices; the troops came from the central army, the provincial levies and a large number of local militia bands as well. The other side was the Second French Empire: Rear Admiral Pierre-Gustave Roze, commander of the Far Eastern squadron, led seven warships and the naval fusiliers, his flagship being the 3,600-ton frigate Guerrière, with roughly six hundred to eight hundred men embarked and another three hundred naval fusiliers standing by at Yokohama; in Peking the acting French minister Henri de Bellonet exceeded his instructions and addressed the Zongli Yamen in a note that even spoke of dethroning the Korean king. Qing China, the suzerain of Korea, was drawn in: under Prince Gong the Zongli Yamen answered that Korea's internal and foreign affairs were its own and that China would not interfere, yet it still passed the news to Seoul and ordered the coastal defences tightened. In the same month of January 1866 Russian vessels appeared off the east coast of Korea demanding trade and a resident, and the talk in the court of Seoul ran on for weeks; that is the international background in which the disturbance took shape on top of the religious persecutions.
people: 核心人物是攝政興宣大院君李昰應：他視天主教為鎖國與王權的威脅，一八六六年下令捕殺教民與法國傳教士，製造丙寅邪獄；洋擾兵臨城下，他仍拒絕和約、拒絕遷都，在宗廟立誓說洋夷侵犯非戰則和、主和賣國，下令加固漢江下游至西海岸的防線、以木筏封住漢江、動員義勇隊。朝鮮一方的將領有御營中軍兼訓練都監中軍李容熙、訓練大將李景夏、李基祚、李元熙，千摠梁憲洙以五百餘名精於射擊的砲手守鼎足山城並設伏擊退法軍，巡撫營哨官韓聖根於十月二十六日在文殊山城擊退法軍，記下全役第一次勝利；江華留守李寅夔逃散、前判書李是遠仰藥自盡。法方由羅澤全程策劃，旗艦艦長奧利維耶率一六〇人攻鼎足山城，普里莫蓋號艦長博謝、拉普拉斯號艦長阿梅、砲艇艇長於歇·德·桑特雷與少尉杜阿爾各領一隊，貝洛內則在外交上越出巴黎本意，事後遭官方譴責。逃到上海的傳教士費利克斯·克萊爾·李福明把教難消息帶到芝罘，直接推動遠東艦隊出兵。
peopleEn: The central figure was the regent Heungseon Daewongun: he regarded Catholicism as a threat to the closed kingdom and to royal authority, and in 1866 ordered the arrest and execution of converts and French missionaries, which produced what is called the Byeongin persecution. When the French came he still refused terms and refused to move the capital, and he swore an oath in the ancestral shrine that a foreign incursion meant either war or peace, and that favouring peace was selling the country; he ordered the lower Han River and the west coast fortified, the river closed with timber rafts, and the militia bands called out. The Korean commanders included Yi Yong-hui of the Royal Camp and the Training Directorate, the great captain Yi Gyeong-ha, Yi Gi-jo and Yi Won-hui; the chief Yang Heon-su manned the fortress of Jeongjoksanseong with more than five hundred gunners and his ambush drove the French back, while Han Seong-geun of the inspectorate's guard turned the French off at Munsusansong on 26 October, the first Korean success of the campaign; the garrison commander of Ganghwa, Yi In-gi, fled and the former judge Yi Seon-won poisoned himself. Roze planned the operation from beginning to end on the French side, the captain of the flagship Olivier leading a hundred and sixty men against Jeongjoksanseong, with Bochet of the Primauguet, Amet of the Laplace, the gunboat commander Huchet de Cintré and Lieutenant Thouars each leading a detachment; in the diplomatic field Bellonet went beyond what Paris had authorised and was afterwards reprimanded by his own government. It was the missionary Félix-Claire Ridel, who escaped to Shanghai, who carried the news of the persecution to Yantai and pushed the Far Eastern squadron into action.
kits: 卡面的加特林機槍是量度此役的一件尺子：這件美國人理查德·加特林構思的多管速射武器，一八六二年取得專利，六根管子靠人力手搖轉動，理論射速每分鐘約二百發，全重約七十七公斤，槍身長約一公尺，需四名射手推轉與裝填；一八六〇年代它還是新鮮事物，美軍到一八六六年才正式採用，最初的實戰在美國內戰，而丙寅洋擾的戰報裡並沒有加特林機槍的射擊紀錄——法艦當時裝的是一八五八年式一六〇毫米線膛後膛砲與二二〇毫米榴彈砲，朝鮮要塞則以清式與日製小薩砲、信砲配合火繩槍應戰。旗艦戰士號載砲三十門、乘員五百四十五人，巡洋艦普里莫蓋與拉普拉斯各一千八百噸、配四門二二〇毫米榴彈砲與六門一六〇毫米砲，砲艇勒布雷松與塔爾迪夫各配一門三二磅砲與兩門二〇毫米砲，偵察艇基安昌由商船改裝、只有四門小口徑砲與四十二人。登陸的海軍陸戰隊用單發後膛步槍配刺刀；法軍在江華島繳獲朝鮮軍械約八千支槍械與若干門砲。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on the card is a ruler for measuring this campaign. The multi-barrel rapid-fire weapon conceived by the American Richard Jordan Gatling, whose patent was validated in 1862, turns six barrels by a hand crank, has a theoretical rate of fire of about two hundred rounds a minute, weighs some seventy-seven kilograms, is about a metre long along the barrel, and needs four men to crank it and feed it. In the 1860s it was still a novelty: the United States Army did not accept it until 1866, and its first combat use came in the American Civil War. No firing record of a Gatling gun appears in the dispatches of the Byeongin disturbance. The French warships carried the previous generation of artillery instead: the model 1858 160-millimetre rifled breech-loading guns and 220-millimetre howitzers, while the Korean fortresses answered with small and new-pattern cannon of Chinese and Japanese make, worked together with matchlock muskets. The flagship Guerrière carried thirty guns and five hundred and forty-five men; the corvettes Primauguet and Laplace, of one thousand eight hundred tons each, carried four 220-millimetre howitzers and six 160-millimetre guns; the gunboats Le Brethon and Tardif carried one 32-pounder and two 20-millimetre guns apiece; the converted merchant aviso Kien Chan had only four small-calibre pieces and forty-two men. The naval fusiliers who landed used single-shot breech-loading rifles with bayonets, and the French recovered from Ganghwa about eight thousand muskets and a number of cannon as their booty.
tactics: 法軍整套動作是海軍式的探路、登陸、封鎖。九月初起三艦沿海偵察，溯漢江至楊花津，繪成三張海圖；船隊吃水深、漢江潮差大而水淺，羅澤遂放棄溯江直取漢城的打算，改為奪取江華島、封死漢江口，用切斷全羅、平安兩道漕米入京的辦法逼朝鮮讓步。十月十一日七艦自芝罘出發，十四日至十六日海軍陸戰隊在甲串鎭登陸，先取控制漢江口的要塞，再攻陷江華府城；此後連續以一二百人的登陸分隊試圖打通陸路，十月二十六日攻文殊山城、十一月七日攻鼎足山城皆受挫。撤退前艦隊盡量搬空府庫官衙，掠走旗幟、砲械、銀錠金塊與二百九十七卷王室儀軌類文書，並縱火焚毀長寧殿等官舍。朝鮮方面的對應是死守城壘：文殊山城周長約二點四公里，砲手伏於城垛後以山地射界俯射登陸隊，木筏橫塞江面，島上與漢江沿岸以鎭管、巡撫營、訓練都監的步兵層層設伏，團練義勇在後方集結，秋收糧道被封仍不妥協。
tacticsEn: The whole French performance followed the naval pattern of survey, landing and blockade. From early September three warships reconnoitred the coast, steamed up the Han River as far as Yanghwajin and drew three charts. Because the squadron drew too much water and the Han was shallow and subject to strong tides, Roze gave up the idea of forcing a way upriver to Seoul and chose instead to seize Ganghwa Island, close the mouth of the Han, and choke the rice and tribute grain that the Jeolla and Pyongyang provinces shipped to the capital, so that Seoul would have to give way. On 11 October the seven ships left Yantai, and between the 14th and the 16th the naval fusiliers landed at the Jabalsu post, taking first the fort that commanded the mouth of the Han and then the fortified city of Ganghwa itself. After that came a series of landings of a hundred or two hundred men in an attempt to open a road inland: the attack on Munsusansong on 26 October and the attack on Jeongjoksanseong on 7 November were both checked. Before withdrawing the squadron stripped the island as far as it could, carrying off flags, cannon, silver ingots, gold and two hundred and ninety-seven volumes of royal protocol, and setting fire to the Changnyeongjeon palace hall and the other government buildings. The Korean answer was to hold the walls: Munsusansong has a circuit of about two point four kilometres, the gunners lay behind the crenellations and brought their mountain field of fire down on the landing parties, timber rafts were laid across the river, the island and the Han shore were held in layers by garrison troops, inspectorate guards and the infantry of the Training Directorate, and the militia bands mustered in the rear; even with the grain road cut at harvest time the court refused to give way.
data: 可核對的數字如下：法方照會總理衙門在一八六六年七月十三日，偵察自九月一日開始，十月一日繪成三張海圖後撤回芝罘，十月十一日七艦出海，十四日至十六日登陸並攻陷江華府，十月二十六日文殊山城受挫，十一月七日鼎足山城受挫，十一月十五日羅澤向上海領事遞交戰報，十一月廿二日撤離江華島，全役約六週。兵力方面，法軍出海六百至八百人、七艦，朝鮮方面守備與民兵合計約一萬人，法方記載十一月守軍達一萬。傷亡方面，法軍全役陣亡三人、受傷約三十五人，文殊山一役另記三人陣亡、三十六人受傷；朝鮮軍陣亡四人（文殊山三人）、受傷二人、失蹤二人。火力配置上，旗艦三十門一六〇毫米砲，巡洋艦各四門二二〇毫米榴彈砲加六門一六〇毫米砲，砲艇各一門三二磅砲加兩門二〇毫米砲，旗艦乘員五百四十五人、巡洋艦各二百人、砲艇各五十二人。繳獲約八千支槍械、二十箱銀錠與二百九十七卷王室儀軌文書；海程由橫濱經上海約八百海里，再由芝罘南下江華約二百五十海里。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The French note to the Zongli Yamen is dated 13 July 1866; the survey of the coast began on 1 September; on 1 October three charts were completed and the squadron pulled back to Yantai; the seven ships sailed on 11 October; the landing and the capture of Ganghwa fell between the 14th and the 16th; the French were checked at Munsusansong on 26 October and at Jeongjoksanseong on 7 November; Roze sent his report to the French consul at Shanghai on 15 November, and the squadron left Ganghwa on 22 November, the whole affair lasting about six weeks. On strength, six hundred to eight hundred Frenchmen in seven ships put to sea, while Korea could muster about ten thousand men in garrison and militia, the French accounts putting the defenders at ten thousand by November. On losses, the French lost three dead and about thirty-five wounded over the campaign, the action at Munsu being given separately as three dead and thirty-six wounded; the Korean forces lost four dead, three of them at Munsu, two wounded and two missing. On the weight of metal, the flagship carried thirty 160-millimetre guns, each corvette four 220-millimetre howitzers and six 160-millimetre guns, and each gunboat one 32-pounder with two 20-millimetre pieces, while the crews numbered five hundred and forty-five, two hundred and fifty-two respectively on the gunboats. The booty was about eight thousand muskets, some twenty boxes of silver ingots and two hundred and ninety-seven volumes of royal protocol; by sea the squadron covered roughly eight hundred miles from Yokohama via Shanghai and then some two hundred and fifty more from Yantai down to Ganghwa.
cause: 洋擾的起因有三層。最外層是教難：一八六六年三月起，興宣大院君在鎖國與士大夫反洋教的氛圍下禁絕天主教，捕殺洪鳳周、南鍾三等官吏與大批信教徒，九名法國傳教士被處決，傳教士李福明逃到芝罘向羅澤報信，遠東艦隊司令當即認定國家榮辱受損；貝洛內不待巴黎指示便致函總理衙門，聲稱法國將暫取其國，把一次教難升格成國家與國家之間的衝突。中層是朝鮮的國策：一八六四年以來的鎖國、拒絕開港與拒絕通商，使朝廷把任何西方存在都視為王權與國家的挑戰，而俄國船隊一八六六年一月出現在朝鮮東岸，更令部分朝臣動搖，甚至動議借法國之力抗俄。最內層是法國的處境：遠東艦隊需要一場勝利來維持在遠東的地位，貝洛內越權把外交先行與海軍示威綁在一起，逼得本可回旋的局面一步逼到底；而朝鮮的答案是興宣大院君寧可決戰也不簽和約。
causeEn: The disturbance had three layers of cause. The outermost was the religious persecution: from March 1866 the regent, in a climate of sealed borders and of scholar-official hostility to foreign religion, banned Catholicism, arrested and executed officials such as Hong Bong-ju and Nam Jong-sam together with great numbers of converts, and nine French missionaries were put to death; the missionary Ridel escaped to Yantai and reported the matter to Roze, and the commander of the Far Eastern squadron at once concluded that the honour of the nation had been wounded. Bellonet then wrote to the Zongli Yamen without waiting for instructions from Paris and announced that France would take possession of the country for the time being, turning a religious crackdown into a clash between two states. The middle layer was the Korean policy itself: the closure of the country begun in 1864, the refusal of ports and of trade, made the court read every Western presence as a challenge to royal authority and to the state, and the appearance of Russian vessels off the east coast in January 1866 unsettled even part of the court, some men briefly suggesting an alliance with France to hold the Russians off. The innermost layer was the position of France itself: the Far Eastern squadron needed a success to keep its standing in the Far East, and Bellonet tied diplomacy and naval demonstration together in a way that left no room to manoeuvre. The Korean answer, given by Heungseon Daewongun, was that the state would rather fight than sign a treaty of peace.
impact: 洋擾的直接後果在朝鮮遠大於法國。攝政的權威空前提高，鎖國與迫害天主教徒的政策反而更緊；德津要塞樹起刻有海門防守、他國船慎勿過的石碑，漢江與江華島一帶大規模增修城壘與砲臺，江華島要塞在法軍破壞後重建，一八七一年又被美軍再毀，一八七四年德浦鎭建起鴈行洞砲臺。朝鮮自此格外留心海上情報與砲兵技術，一八七一年辛未洋擾、一八七五年雲號事件與一八七六年江華島條約接踵而至，開國的時程延後。法國方面則是一場沒有成果的遠征：遠東艦隊威信受損，公使貝洛內越權主張廢黜朝鮮國王而遭巴黎譴責；墨西哥戰事抽走兵力，法國無暇東顧，直到一八八六年才以商善條約重新取得通商權與傳教權。就兵器史而言，加特林機槍這件當年象徵西方火力的武器，最終在一八八四年由朝鮮官方購進六門，一八九一年編成十四門的砲臺，一八九四年兩個美國教練團最多裝備四十門；雖無確定的實戰紀錄，曾經威脅朝鮮的東西，終於成了朝鮮自己的裝備。
impactEn: The direct consequences of the disturbance fell far more heavily on Korea than on France. The regent's authority reached an unprecedented height, and the policy of sealing the country and persecuting Catholics grew stricter rather than looser; a stone stele inscribed with a warning that the sea gate must be defended and foreign ships should not pass was raised at the Deokjin fort, the Han River and Ganghwa Island were ringed with new walls and batteries, the Ganghwa fortifications destroyed by the French were rebuilt and destroyed again by the Americans in 1871, and an artillery position was built at Deokpo in 1874. Korea grew unusually attentive to maritime intelligence and to artillery technique, and the Shinmi disturbance of 1871, the Unyo incident of 1875 and the Treaty of Ganghwa of 1876 followed one after another, pushing back the moment at which the country would open. On the French side the expedition was a success that yielded nothing: the standing of the Far Eastern squadron suffered, and Bellonet was reprimanded by Paris for having talked of dethroning the Korean king on his own authority; the war in Mexico drained the forces France needed, and it was not until 1886 that a treaty of friendship and commerce restored French trade and missionary rights. As for the history of weapons, the Gatling gun, which in 1866 stood for Western firepower, was eventually bought officially by Korea: six guns in 1884, a battery of fourteen by 1891, and as many as forty with the two American-drilled regiments by 1894. There is no firm record of them in battle, but the weapon that had once threatened Korea ended up as Korean equipment.
result: 結果是法軍退走。十月二十六日文殊山城、十一月七日鼎足山城兩次失利，加上冬季逼近、朝鮮援兵在島上集結、艦隊吃水又無法溯江入漢城，羅澤在一八月中旬決定撤退，十一月廿二日全隊離開江華島。法軍全役陣亡三人、受傷約三十五人；撤退前把江華島洗劫一空，焚毀長寧殿及無數官舍民房，搬走府庫金銀、旗幟、砲械與二百九十七卷朝鮮王朝實錄、王室儀軌之類的王室檔案，金銀數額法方與韓方記載自十九萬至五十萬法郎不等；這批書籍成為法國國家圖書館的東亞核心藏品，直到二〇一一年才以永久出借方式送回韓國。朝鮮守住了主權與尊嚴，既未賠款，也未交出涉事官員，更沒有簽通商條約；法方只能以已為九名傳教士報復的說法收場，歐洲在華商民要求更大規模遠征的呼聲也沒有實現。
resultEn: The result was that the French withdrew. The rebuff at Munsusansong on 26 October and at Jeongjoksanseong on 7 November, the approach of winter, the assembling of Korean reinforcements on the island and the inability of the squadron to force its way up the shallow Han all together persuaded Roze to evacuate in the middle of November, and by the 22nd the whole force had left Ganghwa. The French lost three dead and about thirty-five wounded in the campaign; before leaving they stripped the island, burned the Changnyeongjeon hall and countless government and private houses, and carried away the treasury silver and gold, the flags, the cannon and two hundred and ninety-seven volumes of royal archives such as the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty and the royal protocols, the value of the bullion being given from one hundred and ninety thousand to five hundred thousand francs according to the French and Korean records; those books became the core of the East Asian holdings of the Bibliothèque nationale de France and were only handed back to Korea in 2011 on a permanent loan. Korea kept its sovereignty and its dignity: no indemnity was paid, no official was handed over, and no trade treaty was signed. The French could only close the account by declaring that the murder of their missionaries had been avenged, and the European merchants in China who demanded a larger expedition in the following spring got nothing.
